item.title: Sudan war: 200,000 newly displaced as fighting and floods intensify
item.description: Intensifying fighting in Sudan has displaced at least another 200,000 people since late 2025, while destructive seasonal floods are compounding the massive humanitarian emergency there, the UN International Organization for Migration (IOM) said on Wednesday.

item.title: Aid workers under fire as drones reshape warfare
item.description: The UN is warning that aid workers face a deadly and evolving threat, with armed drones reshaping battlefields worldwide – putting humanitarian teams increasingly in the line of fire.

item.title: International Criminal Court: New US sanctions ‘a flagrant attack’ against its independence
item.description: The International Criminal Court (ICC) on Wednesday responded to a new round of US sanctions targeting its president and a senior prosecutor, calling them “a flagrant attack” against the court.

item.title: Zambia: Arrests and detention of political opponents following election raises concern
item.description: In the wake of President Hakainde Hichilema of Zambia’s re-election for a second five-year term, UN human rights chief has raised concerns over the reported arrests and detention of political opponents in the country.

item.title: Raising alarm over new illegal Israeli outposts, UN condemns attacks, incitement against Palestinians
item.description: Reports of new illegal Israeli outposts in the occupied West Bank raised alarms at UN Headquarters on Wednesday while the UN rights office called on Israel to condemn its national security minister’s words that incite “violence amounting to atrocity crimes” against Palestinians.
